lines.zh: 计算机不认识猫这个字，它只认识数字。
lines.en: A computer does not know the word cat. It only knows numbers.

lines.zh: 所以表示学习的第一步，是给每个词一个数字分身。
lines.en: So the first step in representation learning is a numeric stand-in for every word.

lines.zh: 最直接的做法：给词表里的每个词编一个号。
lines.en: The simplest approach: assign an index to every word in the vocabulary.

lines.zh: 编号展开成向量，就是 one-hot 编码。
lines.en: Unfold that index into a vector and you have one-hot encoding.

lines.zh: 这一章讲：词怎么变成向量，又从静态走向动态。
lines.en: This chapter covers how words become vectors, and how vectors became dynamic.

lines.zh: 它决定了大模型第一层能看到什么。
lines.en: It decides what the first layer of a large model can see.

lines.zh: 先看最笨的办法：五万个词，就编五万个号。
lines.en: Start with the dumbest method: fifty thousand words, fifty thousand IDs.

lines.zh: 每个词是一个五万维向量，只有一位是一。
lines.en: Each word becomes a fifty-thousand-dimensional vector with a single one.

lines.zh: 第一个毛病：维度爆炸，几乎全是零。
lines.en: Problem one: the dimension explodes, and almost every entry is zero.

lines.zh: 第二个毛病更致命：任意两个词的内积都是零。
lines.en: Problem two is worse: the dot product of any two words is zero.

lines.zh: 在模型眼里，猫和狗的差距，等于猫和车的差距。
lines.en: To the model, cat-to-dog equals cat-to-car.

lines.zh: 第 1 章的 n-gram 就死在这里：它表达不了相似。
lines.en: The n-grams of Chapter 1 died here: they cannot express similarity.

lines.zh: 那怎么定义意义？语言学家弗斯给了一句座右铭。
lines.en: So how do we define meaning? The linguist Firth left a motto.

lines.zh: 观其伴，知其义：看它常和谁一起出现。
lines.en: You shall know a word by the company it keeps.

lines.zh: 猫常和喵、鱼、毛一起出现，车常和油、轮胎一起出现。
lines.en: Cat appears with meow, fish and fur; car with fuel and tires.

lines.zh: 没有词典，只看朋友圈，也能猜个八九不离十。
lines.en: Without a dictionary, its circle of companions gives it away.

lines.zh: 更早的说法是分布式假设：上下文相似，意义相似。
lines.en: The earlier claim is the distributional hypothesis: similar contexts, similar meaning.

lines.zh: 注意这只是统计倾向，不是定义。
lines.en: This is a statistical tendency, not a definition.

lines.zh: 既然意义等于上下文，就训练模型去预测上下文。
lines.en: If meaning equals context, train a model to predict context.

lines.zh: 2013 年，米科洛夫等人在谷歌提出 word2vec。
lines.en: In 2013, Mikolov and colleagues at Google proposed word2vec.

lines.zh: 两种玩法：CBOW 看周围猜中间，Skip-gram 反过来。
lines.en: Two variants: CBOW predicts the center, Skip-gram goes the other way.

lines.zh: 训练完成后，中间那层词向量，就是词义。
lines.en: After training, the vectors in the middle layer are the meanings.

lines.zh: 目标函数让窗口内邻居的对数概率之和最大。
lines.en: The objective maximizes the log probability of neighbors in the window.

lines.zh: 每个词最后得到一个一百到三百维的稠密向量。
lines.en: Each word ends up with a dense vector of one to three hundred dimensions.

lines.zh: 比五万维稀疏向量，小了两个数量级。
lines.en: That is two orders of magnitude smaller than a fifty-thousand-dimensional vector.

lines.zh: 训练好之后，神奇的事发生了。
lines.en: After training, something remarkable happens.

lines.zh: 国王减去男人，加上女人，最接近女王。
lines.en: King minus man plus woman lands closest to queen.

lines.zh: 巴黎减法国加意大利，最接近罗马。
lines.en: Paris minus France plus Italy lands closest to Rome.

lines.zh: 性别是一个方向，国别是另一个方向。
lines.en: Gender is one direction; nationality is another.

lines.zh: 语义关系，变成了向量空间里的位移。
lines.en: Semantic relations become displacements in vector space.

lines.zh: 但这是近似，不是定律，依赖训练细节。
lines.en: But this is approximate, not a law, and it depends on training details.

lines.zh: 可 softmax 要对整个词表求和，太慢了。
lines.en: But softmax sums over the whole vocabulary, which is far too slow.

lines.zh: 负采样把多分类，改成二分类。
lines.en: Negative sampling turns the multiclass problem into binary classification.

lines.zh: 正样本是真实出现的词对，标签一。
lines.en: Positive pairs really co-occurred; they get label one.

lines.zh: 负样本是随机抽的词，标签零。
lines.en: Negatives are random words; they get label zero.

lines.zh: 计算量从词表大小 V，降到采样数 k。
lines.en: Compute drops from vocabulary size V to k samples.

lines.zh: 不追求精确，追求足够好，再加上十倍速度。
lines.en: Not exact, just good enough, at ten times the speed.

lines.zh: 为什么预测上下文，能学到语义？
lines.en: Why does predicting context teach meaning?

lines.zh: 把它想成一个约束系统。
lines.en: Picture it as a constraint system.

lines.zh: 猫和狗的上下文高度重叠，模型必须给相似的向量。
lines.en: Cat and dog share contexts, so their vectors must be close.

lines.zh: 否则同一套参数没法预测相似上下文，损失会变大。
lines.en: Otherwise one parameter set cannot predict both, and the loss grows.

lines.zh: 于是梯度下降，把上下文相似压成了向量相近。
lines.en: Gradient descent compresses similar contexts into nearby vectors.

lines.zh: 没人告诉模型猫和狗是动物，结构是自己长出来的。
lines.en: Nobody told the model that cats and dogs are animals; the structure grew.

lines.zh: 这就是表示学习：不手工设计特征，让模型自己学。
lines.en: That is representation learning: no hand-built features, the model learns.

lines.zh: 还有个前置问题：词到底是谁定的？
lines.en: One prerequisite remains: who decides what a word is?

lines.zh: 按空格切？中文没空格，英文一个词变几种形式。
lines.en: Split on spaces? Chinese has none, and English inflects one word many ways.

lines.zh: 现代方案是子词：把词切成更小的片段。
lines.en: The modern answer is subwords: cut words into smaller pieces.

lines.zh: BPE 像压缩：初始拆成字符，反复合并最高频的相邻对。
lines.en: BPE works like compression: start from characters, merge the most frequent pair.

lines.zh: 合并到目标词表大小，比如五万或十二万八千。
lines.en: Keep merging until the vocabulary hits a target, say fifty thousand or 128k.

lines.zh: 高频片段早早成为 token，罕见词被拆成几段。
lines.en: Frequent chunks become tokens early; rare words split into common pieces.

lines.zh: 字节级 BPE 以字节为单位，永不 OOV。
lines.en: Byte-level BPE uses bytes, so any text encodes and nothing is OOV.

lines.zh: word2vec 有个根本局限：每个词只有一个向量。
lines.en: word2vec has a fundamental limit: one vector per word.

lines.zh: 吃苹果和苹果发布会，苹果的意思不同。
lines.en: Apple the fruit and Apple the company are different meanings.

lines.zh: bank 在河岸和银行里，也是两个意思。
lines.en: Bank by a river and bank for money are two senses as well.

lines.zh: 静态向量只能取折中，把两个意思平均掉。
lines.en: A static vector can only compromise and average them.

lines.zh: 上下文相关表示，让整个句子过一遍网络。
lines.en: Contextual representations pass the whole sentence through a network.

lines.zh: 2018 年 ELMo 用双向 LSTM，BERT 用 Transformer。
lines.en: ELMo used a bidirectional LSTM in 2018; BERT used a Transformer.

lines.zh: 表示不再是从词典查出来的，而是算出来的。
lines.en: Representation is no longer looked up. It is computed.

lines.zh: 工程上，嵌入就是一个矩阵。
lines.en: In engineering, an embedding is just a matrix.

lines.zh: 每一行是一个 token 的向量，查表就是取一行。
lines.en: One row per token; lookup takes a row.

lines.zh: V 是词表大小，d 是隐藏维度，矩阵是可训练参数。
lines.en: V is vocabulary size, d is hidden size, and the matrix is trained.

lines.zh: 很多模型让输入嵌入和输出层共享权重。
lines.en: Many models tie the input embedding to the output layer.

lines.zh: GPT-3 的 d 是一万二千二百八十八，约六点二亿参数。
lines.en: GPT-3 uses d equal to 12,288, about 620 million parameters.

lines.zh: 光查字典这一层，就比 2012 年的整个 AlexNet 大。
lines.en: This lookup layer alone is bigger than all of AlexNet in 2012.

lines.zh: 还有一维被词袋丢掉了：顺序。
lines.en: One dimension is still missing from the bag of words: order.

lines.zh: 猫追狗和狗追猫，词一样，意思相反。
lines.en: Cat chases dog and dog chases cat use the same words, opposite meaning.

lines.zh: 把词向量求平均，两句话的表示完全相同。
lines.en: Average the word vectors and both sentences become identical.

lines.zh: 解决办法是位置编码：把第几个词也变成向量。
lines.en: The fix is positional encoding: turn the position into a vector too.

lines.zh: 最早用不同频率的正弦、余弦函数生成。
lines.en: The earliest version used sine and cosine functions of different frequencies.

lines.zh: 好处是相对位置能算出来，模型能学会往右看三个词。
lines.en: Relative positions become computable, so the model can look three words right.

lines.zh: 后来有可学习位置和 RoPE，细节留到第 5 章。
lines.en: Later came learned positions and RoPE; details wait for Chapter 5.

lines.zh: 表示学习留下了遗产，也留下了陷阱。
lines.en: Representation learning left a legacy, and also traps.

lines.zh: 第一，相似不等于同义：医生和护士向量近，角色不同。
lines.en: First, similar is not synonymous: doctor and nurse are close but different.

lines.zh: 第二，偏见会被编码：语料的性别倾向会被继承和放大。
lines.en: Second, bias gets encoded and amplified from the corpus.

lines.zh: 第三，各向异性：真实向量挤在锥形区域，余弦不可靠。
lines.en: Third, anisotropy: real vectors crowd a cone, so cosine similarity misleads.

lines.zh: 第四，静态和动态要分清：查表向量不是某一层的激活。
lines.en: Fourth, keep static and dynamic apart: a lookup vector is not an activation.

lines.zh: 所以看到词向量三个字，先问：哪一种？
lines.en: So when you see the word vector, first ask: which kind?

lines.zh: 这一章之后，词已经是向量，还带上了位置。
lines.en: After this chapter, words are vectors, and they carry position.

lines.zh: 但向量之间，还没有互相看的关系。
lines.en: But the vectors still do not look at each other.

lines.zh: 下一章从循环网络讲到注意力。
lines.en: Next: from recurrent networks to attention.

lines.zh: 模型怎么记住前文，又怎么挑重点。
lines.en: How a model remembers context and chooses what matters.

lines.zh: 那是 Transformer 之前必须跨过的一道坎。
lines.en: That is the step you must cross before the Transformer.
